0022600215.text: The Magic (2-7, losers of four straight) visit the Kings (1-8, losers of two straight) for Orlando's 10th game of the season, with Orlando 12th in the East and 4 games back in the Southeast, and Sacramento 15th in the West and 7 games back in the Pacific. Orlando is 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road, while Sacramento is 0-4 at home and 1-4 on the road, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Paolo Banchero, and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons, Domantas Sabonis, and Maxime Raynaud.
